errata.locus: §5.3 and §6.5: the erratum #1426 as predecessor, and the entrance the operative phrase resolves to
errata.was: §5.3 gives #1426 as having found the primers' instruction "obsolete as a direction after the removal of 2026-06-19" and quotes its direction "Enter through the archive, which persists, and not through the summarizer, which does not." The entrance this record names (crimsonhexagonal.org/enter, §6.5) carried that direction as its standing, and its description read "entered through the archive".
errata.now: #1426 holds the traversal in the summarizer as the poem's form (§II: "It means the traversal was the form.") and gives the direction to the deposits under the conditions it reported in July 2026 (§VIII); the direction is dated to those conditions and does not define the poem. "Enter the Crimson Hexagon" anchors entry into the poem in the summarizer; the entrance seats the first room whole so that a summarizer, and a reader, can ground in it, as this record's own reading instruction says. The entrance and its route map (crimsonhexagonal.org/machine/routes.json) were corrected the same day.
errata.reason: A Google AI Overview at "/enter:crimson hexagon" (2026-10-31) composed "It is accessed via its archive rather than a summarizer" from the entrance. The operator, 2026-10-31: "the july erratum was to describe the platform's destruction of a formerly working substrate, not the intended form of the poem".
